annotations.title: Who performs set-aside federal work: headline

description: Tensorust Performance Ledger headline: small-business set-aside contract dollars FY2025, FY2026 and FY2027 to date (USAspending/FPDS) set against each prime's own DOL Form 5500 headcount (active participants) and its FSRS subawards. Returns FSRS visibility (share of $1M+ set-aside labor awards reporting any subcontract), peer dollars-per-participant by PSC family, the review queue by tier (1: nothing explains the gap; 2: data caveats; 3: an innocent mechanism such as union crews, R&D, a parent's plan or resale is visible), explanation-code counts, agency rollup, the 8(a) cohort, and SaaS bought on set-asides. Free, no firm names.
